title: Binance Adds GNS and More Pairs on Cross Margin & Isolated Margin
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has added  GNS   as a new  borrowable asset  on  Cross   Margin  and  Isolated Margin , as well as new margin pairs . New Cross Margin Pairs:   GNS/BTC ,  GNS/USDT New Isolated Margin Pairs:   GNS/BTC ,  KEY/USDT ,  USTC/USDT Explore Binance Margin Now!
